MSC2020 52C35: Arrangements of points, flats, hyperplanes (aspects of discrete geometry)

title: Walls of Silence: The Walls of the 4D 600-cell and 120-cell
description:
Main theorem. The 120-cell, which holds ten inscribed 600-cells, also holds exactly 1200 copies of the Golden Truncated 5-cell A, 1200 of the Golden Cantellated 5-cell B and 600 of the expanded 5-cell C3 (the three shapes that the 5-cell's symmetry group cuts from a 600-cell), all inside the ten 600-cells. Every A copy is hidden in the 120-cell's own walls, while B and C3 copies are hidden only in the walls of their own 600-cell. A and B are the solids of Silent Running (#109), silent in harmonic degrees that their symmetry does not force: they went unseen because they look like the walls of the 600-cell.

The 120-cell holds ten inscribed 600-cells in two states of five, every corner in exactly two. We show that it also holds exactly 1200 copies of the Golden Truncated 5-cell A, 1200 of the Golden Cantellated 5-cell B and 600 of the expanded 5-cell C3, the three kinds of shape that the 5-cell's symmetry group cuts from a 600-cell, all inside the ten 600-cells. Their walls fall into three classes, of 60, 300 and 1200 hyperplanes: every A copy is hidden in the 120-cell's own walls, while B and C3 copies are hidden only in the walls of their own 600-cell, and in each 600-cell the 120 B copies split its 1200 triangles exactly. The 120-cell's own cats are the polar duals of these: the duals of the five orbits of one S5 intersect exactly in the 120-cell, every plate of every dual lies on its 60 mirrors, and their fins cover all its pentagons and edges. A shape is hidden in a host when every central plate of its Vacuus, the hyperplane through the centre spanned by a two-face, is a wall of the host: a mirror, or a cross wall (a central section parallel to a pair of opposite cells). A and B are the solids of Silent Running [1], silent in harmonic degrees that their symmetry does not force. Three face lemmas show why they are hidden in the 600-cell: every triangle of its edges and every golden rectangle on its corners lies on a mirror, and every triangle of side equal to its radius lies on a cross wall. An index law reads the three kinds of Vacuus (heart, inherited heart, non-heart) off the symmetry of each plate. The walls cut the 600-cell into 4,291,200 chambers and the 120-cell, with all 1560 walls, into 593,236,800.

Builds on Silent Running: Twisted Silence (#109, DICTO DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.24272473).

Version 2 has the subtitle "The Walls of the 4D 600-cell and 120-cell", justifies the cross walls from the 25 inscribed 24-cells before they are used, adds a second implementation of the exact arguments, a machine-checked certificate that the fewest covers of Theorem B′ (d) are optimal, the intersection-lattice data behind the chamber counts (Appendix B) and the Proposition 5 enumeration as data, uses the names Golden Truncated 5-cell and Golden Cantellated 5-cell, and keeps only Schrödinger's cat for the Red Queen; the main theorem is unchanged.

Version 3 adds Section 9, the integer Queens E7 and E8: where a permutation group hides (Theorem D) and cats in cross walls only (Theorem E), with Table 5, references [22]–[27] and their sources checked (Appendix A); the main theorem is unchanged.

Computation, proofs, verification and drafting with Claude (Anthropic).
